Dated, sourced reports. Reported events and newly recorded cases are not the same as formal Vatican recognition; the label on each report says which is which.
Pope Leo resumes work as recovery progresses normally

The Holy See Press Office says Pope Leo XIV resumed his work on October 15 as his postoperative recovery progresses normally. Morning routine checks yielded normal results and the chest X-ray showed good recovery of the lung that underwent surgery; he carried out his daily activities independently, and his physiotherapy included a full range of physical activities. He concelebrated Mass in a room prepared for him on the hospital's 10th floor, and in the afternoon met the Substitute for General Affairs, Archbishop Paolo Rudelli.

Aoun invoked Saint Charbel's intercession for Pope Leo XIV's recovery, conveying the Lebanese people's prayers in a message to the pontiff, LBC reported. He said the pope's visit to Lebanon remains firmly rooted in the hearts and the national and spiritual consciousness of the Lebanese, regardless of their religious affiliation.
Catholics Pray for Pope Leo at Gemelli

An evening Rosary was held in Gemelli Hospital's chapel on October 13, presided over by Cardinal Baldassarre Reina, according to Catholic News Service reporting published by the USCCB. Churches and religious communities in Rome were also invited to join in prayer. The Holy See later reported that the Pope's operation was completed successfully.

The NMPRO and MTV feature premiered October 9 at Beirut Media Zone; Lebanese cinema dates differ - VOX lists October 21 sessions, Cinemacity lists October 22. International release and streaming remain unconfirmed.
Mar Charbel Cinema Dates Differ: VOX Lists October 21, Cinemacity October 22

Cinema listings checked October 15: VOX City Centre Beirut lists October 21 sessions (Standard 7:00 and 7:30pm, GOLD 7:30pm; Arabic audio with English subtitles); Cinemacity Beirut lists an October 22 opening with no sessions yet. A listed session is a cinema listing, not a seat guarantee - check your cinema.
From the Historic Photograph to a New Saint Charbel Art Series
The gallery pairs the historic photograph with a new AI transformation series, labeled as artistic renditions, not photographs.
Lebanese and Jordanian Ministers Visit Saint Charbel's Pilgrimage Sites
Lebanon's and Jordan's tourism ministers toured Qozhaya, Bqaa Kafra and Annaya; a visit, not a new agreement or a trail opening.
El Paso Parish Announced an October 3-4 Lebanese Festival
Archived parish announcement, not a post-event report: Saint Sharbel Mission invited El Paso to its Lebanese Festival on October 3 and 4.
Saint Charbel's Formation Monastery Receives Relics from Rome
Kfifan's Monastery of Saints Cyprian and Justina received relics of its two patron saints from Rome.
Beirut Cathedral Consecrates an Altar to Blessed Patriarchs Douaihy and Hoayek
Cardinal Al-Rahi consecrated an altar to Blessed Patriarchs Douaihy and Hoayek at Beirut's Saint George Cathedral. Both remain Blessed, not canonized saints.
Three Priests Martyred at Monte Sole Beatified in Bologna
Cardinal Semeraro beatified three priests killed in the 1944 Monte Sole massacres; recognized as martyrs, no miracle was required.
Emmitsburg Celebrates Nine Years of Saint Sharbel's Shrine
Pilgrims gathered September 26 at the National Shrine Grotto for the shrine's ninth anniversary.
Prayer Walk from Byblos to Annaya for South Lebanon's Christians
Pilgrims walked some 10 miles from Byblos to the Monastery of Saint Maron in Annaya, carrying the intentions of Christians in the southern border villages.
Fulton Sheen Beatified in Saint Louis Before 50,000
Cardinal Tagle presided for Pope Leo XIV as the broadcaster was declared Blessed in Saint Louis; his cause for canonization continues.
The Doctor Who Investigated a St. Charbel Healing Speaks
Dr. Anne Borik, who headed the medical committee in the Dafne Gutierrez case, gave a new interview on how it changed her practice of medicine.
American Priest Walks the St. Charbel Trail
Father Michael Sliney, LC, completed a pilgrimage along Lebanon's St. Charbel Trail and encouraged more Americans to make the journey.
Maronite Patriarch Elias Hoayek Beatified at Dimane
Patriarch Hoayek (1899-1931) was beatified at Dimane before President Aoun; Pope Leo XIV called him a man of dialogue and hope.
Hundreds Honor St. Charbel at Revesby Feast
Hundreds gathered at Revesby, Sydney, for the saint's July feast, one of many annual Maronite parish celebrations.
St. Charbel's Pilgrim Relic Visits Cebu
The Archdiocese of Cebu welcomed the pilgrim relic with a Welcome Mass and three days of public veneration across parishes.
Two New Miracles Reported in Early 2026
Two miracles attributed to St. Charbel's intercession were reported early in 2026; Annaya's register now exceeds 29,680 recorded cases.
First Papal Visit to Saint Charbel's Tomb
Pope Leo XIV prayed at the saint's tomb in Annaya during his apostolic journey to Lebanon, the first pope to do so.

messages.news.latest-news.pope-leo-has-a-good-sec: Pope Leo resumes work as recovery progresses normally
messages.news.latest-news.the-holy-see-press-offi: The Holy See Press Office says Pope Leo XIV resumed his work on October 15 as his postoperative recovery progresses normally. Morning routine checks yielded normal results and the chest X-ray showed good recovery of the lung that underwent surgery; he carried out his daily activities independently, and his physiotherapy included a full range of physical activities. He concelebrated Mass in a room prepared for him on the hospital's 10th floor, and in the afternoon met the Substitute for General Affairs, Archbishop Paolo Rudelli.
messages.news.latest-news.aoun-invoked-saint-char: Aoun invoked Saint Charbel's intercession for Pope Leo XIV's recovery, conveying the Lebanese people's prayers in a message to the pontiff, LBC reported. He said the pope's visit to Lebanon remains firmly rooted in the hearts and the national and spiritual consciousness of the Lebanese, regardless of their religious affiliation.
messages.news.latest-news.catholics-pray-for-pope: Catholics Pray for Pope Leo at Gemelli
messages.news.latest-news.an-evening-rosary-was-h: An evening Rosary was held in Gemelli Hospital's chapel on October 13, presided over by Cardinal Baldassarre Reina, according to Catholic News Service reporting published by the USCCB. Churches and religious communities in Rome were also invited to join in prayer. The Holy See later reported that the Pope's operation was completed successfully.
